title: Latency and timeouts on cloud-api

detection.alert: cloud-api: p99 latency > 2 s for 5 min

impact: Requests slowed down and a share of them timed out on cloud-api
symptom: [ANOMALY] cloud-api 2026-08-29 23:02-23:31: cloud-api: 1 of 18 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-08-29 23:02 and 2026-08-29 23:31 UTC (peak error ratio 0.06 vs baseline median 0.0). 1 error templates, 1 first seen in this span. Peak p95 latency 0.387 s vs baseline band up to 0.416 s.

_templates.macro: Deploy {version_to} of cloud-api made base-image verification synchronous in the request path; the shorter ALB health-check timeout then marked slow targets unhealthy.
_templates.micro: {file}:{line} ({symbol}) calls _verify_sync inline instead of submitting it to the executor.
_templates.remediation: Roll back cloud-api {version_to} -> {version_from}; restore the async executor call at {file}:{line}; revert the aws_lb_target_group health_check timeout.

rca.macro: Deploy v3.51.0 of cloud-api made base-image verification synchronous in the request path; the shorter ALB health-check timeout then marked slow targets unhealthy.
rca.micro: cloud-api/nova/image/cache.py:119 (ImageCacheManager.verify_base_images) calls _verify_sync inline instead of submitting it to the executor.
rca.remediation: Roll back cloud-api v3.51.0 -> v3.50.0; restore the async executor call at cloud-api/nova/image/cache.py:119; revert the aws_lb_target_group health_check timeout.
